Markets.title: How a $900 million bet on SpaceX turned 100x into $94 billion for Alphabet
Markets.summary: Alphabet's initial $900 million investment in SpaceX has grown 100 times to be worth approximately $94 billion. This massive return establishes Alphabet as the rocket company's largest institutional shareholder.

Markets.title: Patanjali Foods Q1 Results: Gross profit rises 35% YoY to Rs 1,521 crore
Markets.summary: Patanjali Foods reported a 29.33% increase in revenue to ₹11,337 crore and a 35.22% rise in gross profit to ₹1,521 crore for the first quarter of fiscal 2027. The company also declared two interim dividends following strong execution across its business segments.

Markets.title: Global Markets: Hotter Europe isn't cooling investor fervor for stocks
Markets.summary: Despite costly heatwaves impacting European industries this summer, stock markets in Paris, Frankfurt, Madrid, and Milan hit all-time highs in August. These record exchanges mirrored recent all-time highs reached by Wall Street's key indexes.

Markets.title: Accel India IV offloads 1.3 pc stake in Urban Company
Markets.summary: Investor Accel India IV sold a 1.3 percent stake in Urban Company through open market deals on August 13, 2026. This transaction reduced the Mauritius-based firm's holdings in the home services platform to 4.84 percent.

Markets.title: Pernia's Pop-Up Shop likely to launch Rs 660 crore IPO by Aug-end
Markets.summary: Purple Style Labs plans to launch a Rs 660 crore initial public offering for Pernia's Pop-Up Shop by the end of August after receiving approval from Sebi. The luxury fashion label will use the funds to expand its business and support its retail operations.

Markets.title: Ashok Leyland Q1 profit rises 2% as revenue jumps 10% to Rs 10,750 crore
Markets.summary: Ashok Leyland reported a 2% increase in consolidated Q1FY27 profit to ₹668 crore, driven by a 10% jump in revenue to ₹10,750 crore from record commercial vehicle sales. Rising material costs pressured margins, prompting the company to implement cost-saving and pricing initiatives.

Geo-Political.title: Instagram accounts fuelling Ceuta crisis with paid advice for help to cross
Geo-Political.summary: A BBC investigation discovered Instagram accounts glamourising the swim around the Morocco-Ceuta border fence. These profiles are operating a network that provides paid advice to help migrants cross into the Spanish territory.

Geo-Political.title: Activists try to deliver aid to Palestinians in homes besieged by Israeli settlers
Geo-Political.summary: Activists are attempting to deliver aid to two Palestinian families trapped in their West Bank homes for several days. Israeli settlers are besieging the properties, preventing the families from leaving.

Geo-Political.title: 'Unprecedented' rain in Japan kills eight people
Geo-Political.summary: Unprecedented rain in Japan killed eight people and cut power to more than 20,000 households. The severe storm also left 7,000 people stranded at Tokyo's Narita airport.

Geo-Political.title: Builders unearth €9m gold stash sealed in walls of Belgian property
Geo-Political.summary: Construction workers in Belgium discovered a €9 million gold stash hidden inside the walls of a cellar while laying sewage pipes. The valuable collection was uncovered unexpectedly during routine property renovation work.

Geo-Political.title: Stolen Matisse artworks recovered by police in Brazil
Geo-Political.summary: Brazilian police recovered eight stolen artworks by French artist Henri Matisse at a home in greater São Paulo. Authorities arrested one man in connection with the theft and recovery of the pieces.

Geo-Political.title: France's top court blocks social media ban for under-15s
Geo-Political.summary: France's highest court blocked a proposed social media ban for children under 15, ruling that the measure violates freedom of expression. President Emmanuel Macron immediately responded by pledging to draft a new version of the legislation.

Data & Insights.title: India's WPI inflation cools marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel prices ease
Data & Insights.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index inflation eased slightly to 9.78% in July due to a moderation in fuel and power inflation to 20.05%. However, inflation in primary articles and manufactured products accelerated during the same month.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise trade gap widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. However, merchandise exports for the April-July period rose 17% to $173.78 billion compared to the previous year.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation slowed to 3.4% year-on-year in July, matching analyst expectations. This moderation could provide the Federal Reserve with greater flexibility regarding interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, staying above the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by higher food and fuel prices, while elevated global oil prices continue to pose economic risks.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings kept India's sovereign credit rating at BBB- with a positive growth outlook, marking the 20th consecutive year at this investment-grade level. The agency also forecasted India's GDP growth at 6.4% while warning of potential fiscal risks from youth employment protests.

Data & Insights.title: The Sanjeev Sanyal interview: A new age of ideas for India
Data & Insights.summary: Sanjeev Sanyal states that artificial intelligence is rendering the traditional university model obsolete. He also notes that India's primary challenge is ensuring employability rather than just job creation.

India.title: Lotte Choco Pie Batch Declared "Unsafe" In Chhattisgarh, Recall Push Begins
India.summary: A specific batch of Lotte Choco Pie has been declared unsafe by officials in Chhattisgarh. Authorities have initiated a recall and warned that legal action will be taken against anyone selling or distributing the prohibited product.

India.title: Rajasthan Set To Table Uniform Code Bill, Could Be Turning Point For Tribal Identity
India.summary: Rajasthan's government plans to introduce a uniform code bill while exempting tribal communities from its scope. This decision has sparked significant debate, particularly regarding tribal identity in the southern region of the state.

India.title: Cockroaches, Lizards: Licences Of Blinkit, Instamart And Zepto Facilities Suspended
India.summary: Maharashtra authorities suspended the licenses of 86 Blinkit, Instamart, and Zepto storage and delivery facilities on Thursday. Inspectors found hygiene violations, including the presence of cockroaches and lizards, during inspections of these online food delivery warehouses.

India.title: Security, Ganga Waters: Issues Ahead Of Proposed PM Modi-Tarique Rahman Meeting
India.summary: Ahead of a proposed meeting between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Tarique Rahman, discussions will focus on security and Ganga waters. The talks aim to address Indo-Bangladesh cooperation and stalled Indian investments in Bangladeshi railway and road infrastructure.

India.title: Trump Requests Supreme Court To Let White House Ballroom Construction Continue
India.summary: The Trump administration asked the Supreme Court to allow construction of a White House ballroom to continue. This petition seeks to overturn a lower court ruling that had temporarily blocked the project.

India.title: Independence Day 2026: When, Where To Watch PM Narendra Modi's Speech On August 15
India.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will deliver his 13th consecutive Independence Day address from the Red Fort on August 15, 2026. The public can watch the speech live across various television channels and online streaming platforms.

General.title: Temporary ban on sale of disposable BBQs over wildfire risk
General.summary: The government has temporarily banned the sale of disposable barbecues due to the severe wildfire risk posed by current drought and heatwave conditions. Officials warn that these single-use grills create a significant danger to the public during this period.

General.title: Weekend cancellations after East Sussex train derailment
General.summary: Three train carriages derailed on an embankment near Lewes, resulting in 20 injuries. This accident caused train cancellations throughout the weekend.

General.title: Chris Mason: Where does this unorthodox by-election victory leave Nigel Farage?
General.summary: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage easily won the Clacton by-election. However, he was conspicuously absent after the election results were announced.

General.title: Britain's Finlay Tarling dies in Volta a Portugal accident
General.summary: British cyclist Finlay Tarling has died at the age of 19 following a serious accident during the eighth stage of the Volta a Portugal. The young rider was competing in the race when the fatal crash occurred.
